integrity: Proof supplied with exact finite entrance identity, compactness argument, unique Poisson-limit optimizer, and reproducible finite cross-checks. Numerical tests do not replace the analytical proof.
limitations: Fixed number of coupon types with diverging integer window length; no joint growing-alphabet uniformity.
The sharp optimization concerns stationary incomplete-to-complete entry frequency, not first completion from an empty collection.
Only asymptotic optimizer rigidity is proved, not exact finite-window uniqueness.
Independent proof validation and exhaustive historical-priority review have not been performed.
title: Optimal nonuniform stationary entry flux for long expiring-coupon windows
